Background tasks for .NET MAUI: [BackgroundTask] classes discovered at startup and run by BGTaskScheduler on iOS and JobScheduler on Android, with a timer while the app runs on Windows and Mac Catalyst. Keeps widgets fresh without the app on screen.

Barcodes for .NET: QR, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417 and the common 1D codes as a module matrix, SVG or a BarcodeView, with fixed symbol sizes such as a 12 × 12 Data Matrix. Also reads a code shown on a grid of lights, such as a word clock. The codec has no MAUI dependency.

MeshBackground for .NET MAUI: a mesh gradient on SkiaSharp, a grid of coloured points blended smoothly, that can drift slowly. Colours from the theme's accent or a preset (Aurora, Sunset), light and dark; a capped frame rate, paused off screen and in the background, still under Reduce Motion.

Remote images for .NET MAUI: a memory and disk cache with downsampling to the view's size off the main thread on iOS, Mac Catalyst and Windows, prefetching on every platform (on Glide's cache on Android), and BlurHash placeholders that show while an image loads.

Camera barcode scanning for .NET MAUI: a BarcodeScannerView and a ready-made scan sheet. Vision on iOS and ML Kit on Android read the standard codes; a light-grid reader reads a code shown by a grid of lamps, such as a word clock.
